LanguageData.CK_BoilWater.label: Boil water
LanguageData.CK_BoilWater.description: Boil one 1 L bottle of water on a campfire or stove, then let it cool into boiled water. Boiling kills germs, so it cannot cause food poisoning.
LanguageData.CK_BoilWaterBulk.label: Boil water (10 bottles)
LanguageData.CK_BoilWaterBulk.description: Boil 10 bottles of water at once on a campfire or stove, then let them cool. Same 300 work as a single bottle.
